question: qué comisión efectiva estamos cobrando
sql: SELECT settlement_batch_id, gross_eur_minor, fee_eur_minor, (fee_eur_minor * 100.0 / NULLIF(gross_eur_minor, 0)) AS effective_fee_pct FROM fact_settlement_batch WHERE settlement_date >= '2024-01-01' AND settlement_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY settlement_batch_id ORDER BY effective_fee_pct DESC LIMIT 10
